description: A prior authorization (pre-approval) denied before care: the appeal path for the plan type, the filing deadline, how fast the plan has to decide a pre-service appeal (30 days for employer plans, 15 per level with two levels; 30 days for Medicare Advantage; 72 hours if urgent), and a draft appeal. Example questions: my prior authorization was denied; insurance won't pre-approve my MRI; how to appeal a prior auth denial.

letter_date.description: Date printed on the letter, if the reader missed it

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say

two_level_appeals.description: Employer plan with two internal appeal levels

urgent.description: True only if the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health. Never infer it.

title: Prior authorization denied
